action.sql: SELECT g.dept_id FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id LEFT JOIN budgets b ON b.entity_id = g.entity_id AND b.period = g.period AND b.account_id = g.account_id AND b.dept_id = g.dept_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'CA01' AND g.period = '2026-04' AND a.type = 'Expense' AND g.account_id BETWEEN '6000' AND '6999' GROUP BY g.dept_id, b.amount HAVING SUM(g.debit - g.credit) > COALESCE(b.amount, 0) ORDER BY g.dept_id
